rules.title: ea or ee: meat/meet, sea/see, week/weak
rules.short_explanation: The sounds /iː/ can be spelled ea or ee: team, beach, meat, meet, teeth and speech. Some pairs sound the same but have different meanings, such as meat and meet or sea and see.
rules.tts_text: The long e sound can be spelled e a or e e.
rules.mnemonic: Eat meat at the beach; see the team this week.

examples.text: We eat meat for dinner on Sundays.
examples.note: Meat is food; it uses ea.

examples.text: Please meet me at the station.
The sea was calm this morning.
examples.note: Sea is water; it uses ea.

examples.text: I can see the warehouse from here.
She felt weak after the long shift.
examples.note: Weak means not strong; it uses ea.

examples.text: We start work again next week.
examples.note: Week is seven days; it uses ee.

rules.title: ai/ay and oi/oy: rain, day, coin, boy
rules.short_explanation: Use ai and oi inside a word: rain, wait, coin and noise. Use ay and oy at the end of a word or syllable: day, stay, boy and enjoy.
rules.tts_text: Use a i and o i inside words; a y and o y at the end.
rules.mnemonic: Inside: ai, oi. At the end: ay, oy.

examples.text: It often rains in autumn.
examples.note: Rain uses ai inside the word.

examples.text: We waited for the train.
The delivery will arrive today.
She painted the office wall blue.
examples.note: Painted uses ai inside the word.

examples.text: We stayed at a small hotel.

examples.note: Coin uses oi inside the word.

examples.note: Noise uses oi inside the word.
